the_original_is_retained_not_deleted.why_retained: the rule was frozen before any profile existed and was applied honestly; the record of what it said, and of how it failed, is part of the evidence and is not edited away

what_specifically_is_superseded.the_failed_element: band = longest contiguous run at or above HALF OF THE PROFILE'S OWN MAXIMUM readrate
what_specifically_is_superseded.why_it_failed: normalising by the profile's own maximum makes the rule scale-free, which was deliberate, but also makes it produce a band on ANY profile with an interior peak, including one that is nothing but a small signal or noise

what_is_carried_forward_unchanged_from_o: k = 1 as the primary readrate threshold, taken verbatim from the official Hit definition
the per-set readout positions, executed verbatim and never harmonised
the pooled profile as the band source, with per-set profiles still reported
the mid-depth and contiguity shape requirements
the Jaccard agreement measure for the V versus D adjudication
the rule that if neither convention agrees, the invocation records that and continues
what_replaces_the_failed_element: significance against a matched-norm random-lens null upper confidence bound, per OA-004 revision 2
claim_ceiling: A record-keeping notice. It licenses no claim of any kind.
